title: Moderating Harm: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Cyberbullying Detection in YouTube Comments

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative error analysis of misclassified comments to assess how models handle culturally specific humor, satire, slang, and coded language.
Manual evaluation of false positives to identify the models' tendency to over-flag emotionally expressive or mental health-related language, even when non-abusive.
